kind: WPF-REQ-04 exact artifact verification identity coverage research
finding: Existing artifact tab truthfully labels Task verification; it does not establish the selected artifact version verification. Original per-artifact requirement remains partially open. Not a claim that the current task-level label is false.

facts.fact: Every selected artifact receives task.verificationStatus alongside its own artifactVersion.

saveArtifact updates latest_artifact_id/version and resets task verification pending; verifyArtifact only updates task status when artifact identity and version equal latest. It stores specific verification detail for exact task/artifact/version/attempt.

Public Detail exposes id/kind/content/mediaType/artifactVersion, no general artifactId, attempt or bound verification reference/status. ArtifactVersion is content hash; different artifact identities can share it.

Plugin result is independently checked and bound to exact latest artifact before setting task status and saving a verification detail. This does not add that association to the general artifact Detail DTO.

counterexampleToAvoid: Task emits artifact A with failed verification, then different artifact B passes. Selecting A may truthfully show current Task verification passed, but that must not be presented as A passed. Matching only title/hash, scanning loaded verification text or using latest task status cannot safely fill the missing identity association.
nextExistingPlan: Record under original WPF-REQ-04/W01 artifact verification acceptance. Ask the existing central evidence/contracts owner for accepted public exact association before a Web consumer; do not invent a duplicate backend task or edit shared contracts from this Web scope. Reuse any existing accepted interface if the owner identifies one.
candidateAcceptance: Return/read an authoritative association for selected task, attempt, artifact id and version, with explicitly pending/unavailable/unknown and verifier-specific meaning; exact existing contract shape remains central-owner decision.

Keep summary and lazy-detail boundaries: no initial full verification/body reads; opening one artifact does not fetch all verification details. Cache by complete public identity/version and connection authority.
A failed / B passed, two different artifacts with same content hash, changed version and reopened retained tab must never borrow another result.
Expose evidence drill-down and task-level aggregate separately, including missing/rejected/stale association. No wording implies process isolation or complete user acceptance from a verifier PASS.
limits: Static source evidence only; no browser reproduction, product import, test, service or provider.
This bounded check does not prove no other accepted artifact endpoint exists elsewhere. Existing-owner intake discovery is required.
No new task, claim, permission, implementation or runtime allocation.

cleanCode.finding: Avoid frontend inference from aggregate task status or content hashes; reuse one authority and bounded lazy rendering.
cleanCode.unresolved: Accepted general per-artifact contract/source owner and actual mounted behavior.
